tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod kyi spyi khrid chen mo bzhugs pa'i

dbu phyogs lags so/ / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi mdog can skyil krung brjid pas bzhugs/ /'dzum zhal dbyibs legs ral gri glegs bam bgrang phreng padmo 'dzin/ /mtshan dpes rab brgyan rin chen sna tshogs stong phrag du mas spras/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi pha rol phyin ma rgyal ba'i yum la 'dud/ / thub pa'i gsung don bka' yi dgongs pa dri med snying po'i bcud/ /pha rol phyin pa bdud kyi gcod yul grub thob brgyud pa'i chos/ /bla ma'i gdams pa gsung gi bdud rtsi rgya chen zab mo'i don/ /legs par bkod pas zhing la char bzhin 'gro la phan gyur cig /gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas byung ba/ sde snod rin po che'i gter mdzod sgo phye ba/ phyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa/ bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dgongs pa lhan cig bsdus pa/ nang rgyud sde rin po che'i dgongs pa gsal bar ston pa/ grub thob dang rtogs ldan thams cad kyi zhal gdams mngon du phyung ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma jo mo lab sgron gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi mchog tu gyur pa man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul 'di yin no/ /'di la bka' rgyud nyams rgyud gnyis/ pho brgyud dang mo brgyud gnyis/ bka' ma dang gter ma gnyis la sogs pa lugs mang du yod kyang*/ 'di de rnams kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing*/ brjod bya lhan cig tu dril nas gcod gzhan dang mi 'gal ba/ gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa zhig ston no/ /bka' pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa/ grub thob rnams kyi zhal gdams/ man ngag bdud kyi gcod yul/ zab don thugs kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sngags dang mtshan nyid thams cad kyi dgongs pa bsdus pa'i chos/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'bras bu phyi dus la mi 'jog par mngon sum du 'byung ba'i chos/

yon tan rin po che lam gzhan gyis phul du dbyung du med pa'i gdams pa 'di'i klad du phyag 'tshal zhing mtshan bstan pa'o/ / chos sku spros bral smra bsam brjod med nam mkha'i dbyings/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dang dpe byad rab ldan zhing*/ /gang la gang 'dul cir yang sprul skus gzhan don mdzad/ /stong nyid snying rje smon lam mthar phyin zhabs la 'dud/ /zhes pa ni rgyu sems can gyi rgyud la bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa gnas pa la brten nas/ rkyen lam gyi dus su mnyam bzhag tu bde stong gsal stong du nyams su blang*/ rjes thob la sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas byams pa dang snying rje smon lam mthar phyin pa'i byed pas/ 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsum ye shes lnga phrin las bzhi dang bcas pas gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /dbu ma las/ dngos med rnam dag nam mkha' mnyam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus tshig med yi ge bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'das dang ma byon kun tu song la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas ma lus thams cad stong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa chos sku'i byed pa yin no/ /gzugs sku'i byed pa'ang*/ sdud pa las/ skye bo'i dbus na sgyu ma'i skyes bu mkhas pa zhig /skye bo 'di mgu bya snyam mi sems de yang byed/ /sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs rab tu ston par byed mthong yang*/ /de la lus med sems med ming yang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /sku gnyis ka'i byed pa yang*/ spyod 'jug las/ yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /ji ltar re ba yongs skong ba/ /de bzhin gdul bya'i smon lam gyi/ /dbang gis rgyal ba'i skur snang ngo*/ /zhes so/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa theg pa chen po'i chos/ /'khor 'das dgag sgrub med pa pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /'gal rkyen lam du 'khyer ba a ma jo mos bzhed/ /mi mthun grogs su 'dod pa gcod kyi gdams pa bri/ /zhes pa ni bdud dang 'byung po 'gal rkyen bar chad la sogs pa thams cad 'dus byas yin snying po med/

kun rdzob yin 'jig par sla/ byas pa yin te/ mi rtag pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi chos don dam pa 'dus ma byas pas zil gyis mnan par nus so/ /'bum las/ gzugs rtag cing brtan la ther zug pa mi 'gyur ba'i chos can zhig yin na ni/ theg pa chen po 'dis kyang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis gnon par mi nus so/ /gzugs mi rtag mi brtan la ther zug ma yin 'gyur ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po 'dis kyang*/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis gnon par nus so/ /zhes so/ /'khor 'das gnyis la dgag sgrub med pa ni/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das/ sems can dang sangs rgyas/ dug lnga dang ye shes lnga/ rnam rtog dang chos nyid la sogs pa'i bde sdug mtho dman bzang ngan gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad la blang dor dang dgag sgrub bya mi dgos te/ blang bya'i chos thams cad kyang don la bden par ma grub stong pa nyid yin la/ spang bya'i chos thams cad kyang rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na nam mkha'i klong du sprin dkar nag gnyis char yal nas stong par song ba bzhin no/ /de ltar dbyer med du ma rtogs pas glo bur gyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa'o/ /'bum las/ gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong*/ tshor ba ni tshor bas stong zhes so/ /de gang gis rtogs na pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bdud kyi gcod yul 'di nyams su blangs pas rtogs so/ /'gal rkyen lam du 'khyer ba ni/ kun mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas mi 'grub rgyu thams cad/ 'gal rkyen gyis byas pas 'gal rkyen lam du 'khyer ba skom thag chu nang du gcod pa/ nad pa lha 'dre la gtod pa/ skyel ma dgra la 'chol ba/ mi mthun grogs su 'dod pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa 'di a ma jo mo'i bzhed pa yin no/ /mi mthun pa'i gdon dang bgegs dang*/ dgra dang 'dre/ 'gal rkyen bar chad/

na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa spang bya thams cad byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su 'dod de/ rgyu las ngan sdig sgrib dag /rkyen lam gyi gegs sel/ rtogs pa'i bogs thon/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi yon tan skyed pa'i phyir ro/ /mdo las/ chos phyir srog kyang 'dor la rnal 'byor rab tu brtson/ /mi ldog rtags ni 'di dag yin par shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de rnams ston pa'i gcod kyi gdams pa/ zab don thugs kyi snying po 'di/ /kun la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /bri bar bya'o zhes pas/ nang du lta ba'i mtha' chod/ sgom pa'i phugs chod/ spyod pa'i blang dor chod/ 'bras bu'i re dogs gcod pa'o/ /phyi ru sdang ba'i dgra la gcod/ gnod pa'i bgegs la gcod/ chags sdang gi yul dang*/ 'gal rkyen thams cad la gcod pa'i phyir na gcod ces bya'o/ /tshig don rtogs shing byams sems rab brgyan mkhas brgyad ldan/ / rang don mthar phyin stong nyid snying rje sgrub dang rkyen sel mkhas/ /zhes pa ni/ man ngag 'di ston pa'i slob dpon la mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ lta bas 'khor 'das gnyis su snyems thag chod nas phung po gzan du bskyur ba la mkhas pa/ sgom pa yid la byar med pa shes nas dran pa yengs med du skyong ba la mkhas pa/ grub mtha' snang stong bden med kyi don mngon du gyur nas/ 'khor 'das sa mtshams 'byed pa la mkhas pa/ tshig khrid blang dor med pa'i rgyab skyor ston pa la mkhas pa/ don khrid sha khyer khrag khyer kyi man ngag ston pa la mkhas pa/ nyams len 'bogs pa la mkhas pa ste/ mkhas pa brgyad dang ldan pa zhig gis bshad par bya'o/ /dad dang brtson 'grus mos gus go cha snying rus ldan/ /'jigs skyob mngon mtho legs smon kun mkhyen thob 'dod pas/ /zhes pa ni chos 'di nyams su len pa'i slob ma ni/ dad dang brtson 'grus shes rab che/ / snying khams snying rus sdug bsran che/ /nga rgyal ser sna g.yo sgyu dang*/

/phrag dog 'dod chags zhen pa chung*/ /bla ma la gus skye shis 'jigs/ /de rnams rin chen gser snod yin/ /yang na gang zag sdug bsngal can/ / nad dang gdon gyis nyen pa dang*/ /'chi la thug dang mdze rigs can/ / brtag pa mkhan nam sman pas bor/ /rtsis mkhan mo ma mngon shes mkhan/ / rtag par skur zhing 'chi dus btab/ /de yang chos 'di'i snod du shes/ / yang na skye bo dad pa can/ /'chi bas 'jigs shing mos gus che/ /ci gsung bka' la nyan pa ni/ /chos 'di nyan pa'i snod du shes/ /zhes pas gang zag che ba gsum dang ldan pa zhig gis nyams su blang bar bya ste/ rtogs pa'i rbad khams che ba/ lus srog gtong phod che ba/ gcod kyi snying khams che ba'o/ /de rnams dang ldan pa zhig la gdams ngag 'di bshad par bya'o/ /dbang bskur mchog thob zab mo nyan pa'i snod du gyur/ /bsags sbyong lam gyis sems nyid rtsal la ngo sprod bya/ /zhes pa ni gtor ma'i dbang la brten nas chos sgo 'byed pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs la brten nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ rig pa rkyang 'ded la brten nas sems btsal ba/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed la brten nas ngo sprod dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni slob ma'i rgyud chos 'di nyan pa'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma'i dbang la brten nas chos sgo 'byed par bya'o/ /de nas byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs kyi lung phog la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab cing tshogs bsags pa dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang ba'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o/ /de nas gsum pa nyams len thams cad kyi mthar thug sgom yin/ sgom thams cad kyi mthar thug sems 'tshol ba yin/ rnam rtog rtsad chod la brten nas sgom skye bas sems btsal bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni de rnams sngon du song nas/ slob dpon gyis rten can rten med kyi sgo nas nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi sgom ngo sprad par bya'o/

/de rnams logs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar sngon 'gro'i ngo sprod thebs pa gal che ste/ /ngo ma 'phrod par gcod la phyin te/ lus ster du bcug na lha 'dre la drangs pa'i tshod yin pas bar chad rkyen du 'gyur ro/ /ngo legs po 'phrod na gcod kyi gdams ngag bzhin ma bstan kyang gnyan khrod 'grim nus pa yin no/ /de rnams legs par tshar ba dang gcod kyi gdams pa bstan par bya'o/ /de yang dbang skur ba ni/ phyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos lugs su byed na gtor dbang tsam yang bskur mi dgos te/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las dbang bskur bar bshad pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gsang sngags ltar byed na gtor dbang tsam zhig bskur bas chos sgo 'byed de/ gtor dbang de la bum pa'i dbang bdun/ mchog dbang gsum ste/ dbang bcu tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na sngags mtshan nyid gnyis la/ don dam lta ba'i sgo nas khyad par med kyang*/ kun rdzob thabs kyi sgo nas khyad par yod pa'i phyir ro/ gcod kyi lta ba pha rol du phyin pa'i dgongs pa yin yang sgom pa dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ dbang dang ngo sprod gsang sngags kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams gsang sngags bzhin bya'o/ /des na/ snod rung gi skabs su dbang bskur/ sgrub thabs su bskyed rim lha bsgom snying po sngags bzla/ rdzogs rim rlung bsgoms kyang*/ spyod pa dam tshig dang 'gal na/ 'bras bu mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mi 'byung ngo*/ /ngo sprod kyi skabs su rtog med sgom pa la sgo gsum la las mi 'chol ba zhig dgos pas/ lus kyi 'dug stangs/ kag langs pa dang*/ thal mo dang khu tshur spyi bo dang*/ snying khar sbyar na/ lus la las 'chol ba'i phyir/ des yengs nas sgom mi skye/ des na skyil krung dang mnyam bzhag bya'o/ /des lus kyi rtsol ba spangs pas lus bde/ lus bde bas sems bde/ sems bde na sgom rang bzhin gyis skye ba'i phyir ro/

/skyil krung mnyam bzhag kyang lus gnad yin pa sngar gyi dang khyad med lus la las bcol ba mnyam mo zhe na mi mnyam ste/ langs pa dang bsdad pa la rtsol ba che chung gi khyad yod pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag tu a bgrangs na ngag la las 'chol ba yin pas/ des yengs nas sgom mi skye bas/ ngag smra brjod dang bral ba'i ngang du bzhag pas rig pa rtog med kyi dbyings su 'gro ba'o/ /yid kyis a sgom pa dang*/ 'od kyi spro bsdu byas na sems la las bcol bas des yengs nas sgom mi skye bas/ yid dran rtog med pa'i ngang la bzhag pas de kho na sgom yin no/ /bka' tshoms las/ rang lus gang bder 'dug byas nas/ /mi bsam bsam par mi bya 'o/ /bsam pa yul yin de mi rnyed/ /de bas mi bsam ngang la zhog /ces so/ /sgom zhes bya ba ste/ shes bya'i yul las 'das pa/ rtog dpyod kyi blo dang bral ba/ smra bsam brjod med tsam yin nam min/ yin na sngar gyi lus gnad dang bzlas pa dang spro bsdu/ de rnams byas pas mi yong*/ bya dgos kyang mi dgos lus la sems kyis khyab pas/ sems de gcig tu sdud pa la sogs pa bya mi dgos te/ khyab pa dang dngos po can gcig tu khyab pa med/ dngos med kyis khyab pa yin/ dngos med de gcig tu sdud rgyu med/ bsdu mi dgos/ gang khyab pa de rang du yal du bcug pas chog go /dper na nam mkha'i sprin yal ba'i tshe na/ gcig tu bsdus nas yal du bcug mi dgos te/ sprin gang du gnas pa de nyid du yal ba bzhin no/ /spyir yang sems kyi ngo bo dang po med pa zhig yin pa la de la yig 'bru dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon du sgom pa la sogs pa mi 'thad de/ med pa yod par bsgyur ba'i khyad par yang dngos por bsgyur ba bya ba log pa yin pas/ gshis kyi 'dug tshul de stong pa yin pas stong nyid du ngo sprad pas chog go /kho na re/ a dang 'od kyi spro bsdu ngo sprod pa min/ de la brten nas dngos med du ngo sprad pa yin pas 'gal ba med do zhe na/

'gal ba yod de dngos med du ngo sprad pa la dngos po la brten nas ngo sprad mi dgos te/ dngos med rten gang la'ang ma brten par ngo sprad pas chog go /de skye ru mi 'dod do zhe na/ ma skyes pa de kho na la ngo sprad pas chog go /ma mthong ba de lam zer kyin 'dug ste/ lam ma bgrod na nye/ sgom ma bsgom na bzang*/ lta ba blta rgyu med na mthong*/ spyod pa dgag sgrub bral na btsun/ dam tshig bsrung bya srung byed med na gtsang*/ 'bras bu re ba med na thob ces gsungs pas so/ /sgom de dngos po can zhig skye dgos na/ rten zhig la ma brten par skye ru mi 'dod par bden gyi/ dngos med zhig go bar byed pa la rten mi dgos zhes bya'o/ /des na nam mkha' sgo 'byed gyi ngo sprod ni sdig po che gseb lam la 'khrid pa'i 'pho bar byas na 'thad de zhes dang por rang la skye med dga' yan zhes bya ba/ phyi mtshan nyid kyi bka' bzhin shes/ nang gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi shes pa'i gcod mkhan chen po des bzhed pa yin no/ /yang kha cig na re lus la sems kyis khyab nas yod/ gram nas yod byas pas de mi 'thad de/ sems dngos med yin pa'i phyir/ khyab byed du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhe na/ 'gal ba med de/ de la lung rigs pa dpe yod de/ dgyes rdor las/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o/ /zhes so/ mdo las/ dper na bar snang sprin bzhin gnas pa med par gnas/ /gnas med gnas yin 'di ni rgyal bas gnas par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rigs pa ni/ mgo nas rkang pa'i bar du phan gnod gang byas kyang sems kyis bde sdug nyams su myong ba'i phyir ro/ /dpe ni rnga'i sgra la dngos po med kyang rnga lpags kyis khyab tshad du sgras khyab pa bzhin no/ /ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs the tshom gcad bya'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i lam 'di skal ldan rnams kyis legs par bzung*/

/zhes pa ni gcod kyi gdams pa 'di gang zag gang gis nyams su blang na gang zag bzhis nyams su blang ste/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang*/ phyogs tsam zhig rtogs pa dang*/ the tshom dang bcas pa thams cad kyis nyams su blang ba'o/ ma rtogs pa ni/ nang na bdag med pa/ phyi na 'dre med pa/ bar na 'gal rkyen med par ma rtogs pa'o/ /log par rtog pa ni/ nang na bdag yod pas gnod bya bden par rtog /phyi na 'dre yod pas gnod byed bden par rtog /bar na 'gal rkyen yod pas bar chad bden par rtog go /phyogs gcig tsam rtogs pa ni/ bdag tu 'dzin mkhan med par shes kyang 'jigs pa stong par ma shes/ 'dre la 'jigs rgyu med par shes kyang 'jigs yul stong par ma rtogs/ 'jigs yul dang 'jigs mkhan med par rtogs kyang na tsha bar chad tsam zhig bden pa med par ma rtogs/ 'dre yod pa bden nam mi bden nam snyam pa'i the tshom dang bcas pa thams cad kyi snyems gcad pa'i phyir gcod bya'o/ /yang lam gyi nyams len thams cad la gegs byung na/ bsal bar bya ba'i phyir du gcod bya'o/ /lta sgom spyod pa la skyed med na bogs 'don par bya ba'i phyir du'ang gcod bya'o/ /gcig pur gnyan sa de ru phyin pas dge sbyor la 'debs kyang mi 'chor te/ sngon chad la yengs ma lam tu shor bas lan pa yin no/ /gnyis par nang gi 'jigs mkhan dang phyi'i 'jigs yul gnyis rkyen dang phrad nas nyams su blangs pas skom thag chu nang du chod 'gro /gsum pa gang na mi nus mi phod pa de la thog rdzis byas pas pho shan phyed de/ blo gdengs dang ldan pas 'khor 'das gnyis kyi pho shan phyed pa yin no gsungs pa'o/ /bdud ni nyon mongs lha dang phung po 'chi bdag bdud/ khyad par thogs bcas thogs med dga' brod snyems byed bdud/ /zhes pa'i bdud kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gang zhig dge ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'o/ /dbye ba ni chos spyi skad du/

nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ lha'i bu'i bdud/ phung po'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi ru yod la/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud ni dug lnga yin pas dge ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'o/ /lha'i bu'i bdud ni nang du yon tan skyes pa'i tshe spro dga' dang nga rgyal dang*/ dregs pa dang rlom pa skyes nas yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba la bar chad byed pa yin no/ /phung po'i bdud ni/ lus rgas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ rgud par byed pa'o/ /'chi bdag gi bdud ni 'chi rkyen la brten nas srog gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'o/ /ma gcig jo mos kyang bzhi ru gsungs te/ thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud/ /ces so/ /thogs bcas kyi bdud ni me dang chu dang dug dang mtshon dang gcan gzan g.yang sa la sogs pa dbang po'i yul du snang ba rnams yin te/ de la gcad pa ni tshogs lam sbyor lam man chad du/ sa ma thob pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ de'i dus su rten lus dbang che/ brten pa sems kyi dbang ma thob pas nad dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa mi 'dod bzhin du 'ong*/ brtul zhugs mngon shes ma thob pas/ 'byung ba bzhi la thogs te thogs bcas kyi bdud yin pas gcad par dka'o/ /mthong lam thob pa nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yin te/ da dung sangs rgyas sa ru ma slebs pas/ lam sbyang dgos te/ lam du dka' ba spyad kyang na tsha dang sdug bsngal mi myong bas/ dka' spyad ltar snang ba tsam yin pas ngal ba dang dub pa med do/ /dper na rtag tu ngus lus sbyin par btang ba'am/ nā ro pa me dang g.yang sa la sogs pa la mchongs pa lta bu yin te/ sa thob 'jigs pa lnga dang bral/ /zhes so/ /de'i dus su thogs bcas bdud la gcod byas pas chog go /thogs med bdud ni phyi'i bdud lha 'dre dang nang gi bdud nyon mongs pa dang*/ na tsha sdug bsngal la sogs pa yul gyi myong tshor phra ba dang rags pa 'di rnams yin te/

de ni sa ma thob kyang gang zag gnyen po dang ldan na tshogs sbyor gyi dus su'ang bcad pas chog go /dga' brod kyi bdud ni/ gcod kyi gdams ngag nyams su blang ba la brten nas phyi ru bdud kyis ma tshugs pa dang nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba la brten nas/ da 'di nyams su blangs pas nus pa dang byin rlabs 'byung*/ zang zing 'du ba dang/ bsod nams 'byung*/ snyan pa dang grags pa 'byung*/ phyi nang gi yon tan rgya chen po 'byung ngo snyam pa'i re ba dang bcas/ 'dod pa dang bcas/ dga' ba dang bcas/ brod pa dang bcas nas phan yon gyi 'bras bu la dmigs nas gcod byas na/ dga' brod kyi bdud yin pas gcod kyi phan yon la dga' brod med par nyams su blang ngo*/ /de bas na sangs rgyas la'ang re ba dang 'dod pa med pa zhig dgos te/ snyems byed kyi bdud ni/ bdag dur khrod dang lung stong dang 'brog dgon pa la sogs pa'i gnyan khrod rnams su phyin yang bdag la bar chad mi 'byung ste/ de ci'i phyir na bdag la lha dang bla mas gzigs/ dkon mchog gsum gyis skyob/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung mas srung zhing yod snyam pa'i nyams 'cha' ba dang*/ gcod kyi gdams pa zab mo'i gnad yod snyam pa'i gdengs 'cha' ba dang*/ nang lha med 'dre med phyag rgya chen po'i don gyi nyams len bzang po yod snyam pa'i ngar dang*/ lha 'dre'i bar chad byung yang lus byin pas chog /ster nus na 'dre mi yong*/ 'khyer mi nus bza' mi nus/ kho rang log nas 'gro ba de ltar du byas pas chog snyam pa'i bsam pas/ gcod byed pa ni snyems byed kyi bdud yin pas/ dang po gcod la 'gro tsa na'ang bla ma dang dkon mchog gis bsrung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol mi zer/ na tsha dang 'gal rkyen mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol mi zer/ bdud dang 'byung po 'dre gdon dang bgegs zhi bar byin gyis rlobs mi zer/ 'o na ci zer na/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum la bskyabs pas 'gal ba med de/

gsol ba 'debs lugs mi 'dra bas 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad lam la slongs par byin gyis rlobs/ lus kyi bdag 'dzin blos thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ bde sdug ro snyoms par byin gyis rlobs/ gcod kyis bdag 'dzin grol ba'i nyams len mthar phyin par byin gyis rlobs byas nas 'gro ba yin no/ /gnyan sa de ru slebs nas kyang bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros srung skyob byed kyi/ phyag rgya chen po'i sgom yod pas yong mi nus kyi/ gcod kyi gdams ngag yod pas mi thub kyi snyam pa'i snyems mi 'cha'/ gdengs dang ngom mi byed par/ gdengs med/ mgon med/ skyabs med/ gnyen med/ bshes med/ 'khri ba med/ rgyab dang dpung med par rang gcig pur khris se nyal nas sdod pa yin/ cho 'phrul dang gdug rtsub ci byung yang*/ nga la ni mgon med skyabs dang dpung gnyen med/ 'thab ni mi 'thab/ 'bros ni mi 'bros/ zon ni mi byed/ khyod rang ni dga' dus 'ongs pas chog dbang ni yod/ ci byed pas chog /snyam du bsam la snyems med par bya'o/ / lar las dang po pa'i gang zag gi dus su bdud bzhi po de yod de byung yang skyon med de/ thogs bcas dang thogs med kyi bdud ni med na gcad pa'i yul med/ yul med na gcod la 'gro don med/ phyin yang bogs mi 'byung*/ yon tan mi skye'o/ /dga' brod kyi yon tan ma bsam na/ gcod la 'gro mkhan mi yong*/ ston thog gi 'bras bu la ma bsams na so nams byed mkhan med pa'am/ tshong pas tshong khe ma dran na tshong la 'gro mkhan mi yong ba dang 'dra ba yin/ nyams len dang gdams ngag gi snyems med na/ gnyan sa la 'gro mi nus te/ dper na dpa' bo lag cha med na g.yul du 'jug mi nus pa dang 'dra/ des na dang po'i dus su lha'i bu'i bdud dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang*/ phung po'i bdud dang*/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dang*/

bdud bzhi spong yang mi spong ste/ byung yang skyon chung gsungs so/ / nad gzhi sman gyis spong la/ sman nad pa sos kyis spong ba dang 'dra bas/ dga' brod snyems byed gnyis gcod klong du gyur pa las mi spongs ba phyis spongs pas chog go /dur khrod lung stong lha khang shing gcig khang stong sogs/ /rang sems gang 'jigs nyams nga bag tsha'i gnas su nyal/ / zhes pa ni gcod byed pa la sa dmigs gnyan po btsal ba gal che ste/ 'og gdon drag po gnas pa'i sa ni/ chu mig mgo dgu /mgo bdun mgo lnga mgo gsum mgo gcig pa nas rim pa bzhin du klu gdol pa/ bram ze/ rje rigs rgyal rigs/ dmangs rigs gnas so/ /chu mig chu ral chu 'khyil 'dra ba nyi ma mi 'char ba na klu bran gnas/ mtsho drung lu ma shing gcig bra ma ne'u sing chu ljab 'jib yod pa na gnyan gnas/ pha 'ong dug sbrul sbal pa phag 'dra ba na sa bdag gnas/ ri brag rus sbal sdig pa/ sdom gzugs 'dra ba dang*/ g.yag dang chu glang rnga mong ma he'i gzugs 'dra ba na/ sa bdag klu gnyan chen po gnas/ brag gdong dang ri sna gad pa'i steng mi rengs langs pa 'dra ba dang*/ spre'u'i gdong pa 'dra ba dang*/ ral gri 'dra ba/ khrag gi ral pa 'dra ba dmar ba na btsan gnas so/ /nag pa na bdud gnas so/ /brag skyibs dang phug pa gcong rong gad phug grog phug na dam sri/ bsen mo the rang gnas so/ khang stong re hrul phung shul/ 'brog pa bskyas pa'i shul/ sa kha/ tshong pa na gri bo gri mo/ bse rags mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags gnas so/ /dur khrod 'chad pa ro khung srib khang*/ shi ba'i shul/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i shul du/ ma mo gshin rje srog bdag gnas so/ /lha khang*/ mchod rten/ dkor khang*/ 'phyams gog /mgon khang sgrub khang*/ dben pa de rnams la rgyal po dkor bdag pe kar gnas so/ /mdor na gnas la mang du bshad kyang*/ rang re nyam nga zhing bag tsha ba/ gang 'jigs pa snyam byed pa de ru gcod byed do/

/de rnams ni sems kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ rang sems gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ stong nyid nyams su len pa dang rnal 'byor pho shan 'byed pa dang*/ 'khor 'das 'khrug shan 'byed pa dang*/ shes pa'i gnas yin/ de rnams kho nar nyal du 'gro dgos so/ /rang gi khyim du nyal bas mi chog gam snyam na/ 'gro dgos te de rnams la lha 'dre dngos su grub pa med kyang nang 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa de/ de rnams su phyin na skye ba'i phyir/ 'gro dgos so/ lar gcod 'di la phyi 'dre la gcod pa dang*/ nang sems la gcod pa gnyis yin te/ 'dre che sar nyal du 'gro yang do bsdo ba yang min snyad 'tshol ba yang min/ 'dre yul nas 'don pa yang min/ 'dres dngos grub ster du re ba yang min/ 'o na gnyan pa dang 'dre che sar phyin nas ci byed snyam na/ phyi na 'dre med kyang*/ nang na 'drer 'dzin dang*/ bdag 'dzin dang*/ gces 'dzin yod pas de gcod pa dang*/ dngos med du gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir gnyan sa der 'gro ba yin no/ /phyi 'jigs pa'i rkyen la brten nas nang 'jigs mkhan gyi shes pa de rtsa brdar gcod pa yin no/ /de ltar byas pas/ lam rkyen gyis rkyen thon/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyi bogs thon nas 'ong ngo*/ /mi phod pa la thog rdzis bya/ mi nus pa la ro snyoms byas pas/ lam gyi gegs bsal nas yon tan skye'o/ /mi phod pa'i yul drug yod de/ me dang chu/ dug dang mtshon/ khyi dang g.yang rnams srog la rgol bas mi phod/ de ni sngar thogs bcas dus su bstan zin to/ /lha 'dre nyam nga bas mi phod de/ bdag 'dzin blos btang nas kho la ster/ bdud rtsi lnga la skyugs bro bas mi phod de/ phan yon bstan pas dam rdzas su shes par byas nas de'i gdeng gis ro snyom mo/ /ma sring la ngo tsha bas gcer bu la sogs byed mi phod de/ tshogs drug bden med du shes pas ngo tsha mkhan rtsa ba bcad/ sgro skur dang ngan smras phyar kha mi snyan pa'i mi phod de/

sgra grag stong du shes pas nyam nga bag tsha ro snyom/ nor zas longs spyod rang la mkho ba dang*/ zhen pas ster g.yar byed mi phod de/ de la snang srid sgyu mar shes pas sbyin gtong bya'o/ /thams cad sems su shes pa'i phyir na mi phod pa la thog rdzis byed pa la dga' bas thog rdzis byed pa gal che'o/ /mtshan mo nyam nga lha 'dre 'du zhing rnam rtog skye/ /the tshom gcod dang gegs sel bogs 'don tshe na bya/ /zhes pa ni/ dus ni mtshan mo mun pa'i dus su 'gro bar bya'o/ /nyin mo'i dus su gang du phyin yang 'jigs pa mi yong ste/ zla bo dang 'grogs nas phyin na'ang gnas gang du phyin gang du nyal na'ang 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /'jigs pa ma byung na/ yon tan mi skye ste gcod byed pa la gcad yul med pa'i phyir/ dper na nam mkha' la ral gri brgyab pa bzhin te/ chod ma chod kyi tha snyad med do/ /nang nas 'jigs pa dang nyam nga med na phyin ma phyin med de/ 'jigs pa kho na gcod par byed pa yin/ 'jigs pa med na gcad rgyu med pa'i phyir/ dper na byol song ngam ri dwags gnyan sar phyin pa dang*/ lce spyang dur khrod nyul yang gcod kyi yon tan mi skye ba bzhin no/ /gcod byed pa la 'jigs yul dang 'jigs mkhan med pa zhig kho na 'dod pa min nam/ de chod pa'i rtags yin no snyam na/ ma yin te/ gcod ma byas par ye nas 'jigs pa med pa dang*/ gcod byas nas 'jigs mkhan dang 'jigs yul stong par gtan la phebs pas 'jigs pa med pa gnyis don go mi gcig go /des na nyam nga bag tsha ba dang/ the tshom skyes pa dang*/ gegs sel ba dang*/ bogs 'don pa'i dus su 'gro bar bya'o/ /'gro tshul yang*/ zhe sdang dang 'gran sems kyis mi 'gro /rgan nyams pho tshod kyis mi 'gro /pho rus dang khe grags kyis mi 'gro /nga rgyal dang che chos kyis mi 'gro /grags pa dang lo 'dod kyis mi 'gro /rnyed pa dang bkur stis mi 'gro bar nges 'byung gi dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs te 'gro bar bya'o/

/kun mkhyen 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro dang gsol ba gdab/ /sems skyed mchog ldan 'gro kun thar pa thob pa'i lam/ /zhes pa ni/ ci byed kyang sngon 'gro sems bskyed kyis bzung na/ gang byas kyang lam du 'gro /ci byas na'ang 'gro don yin pas/ gnyan khrod du gcod la 'gro ba'i dus su/ bka' pha rol du phyin pa'i dgongs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gshegs yul/ bla ma grub thob rnams kyi phyag bzhes/ lam zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul gyi gdams pa 'di nyams blang bar bya'o/ /sems can ma rtogs rnams kyis rtogs par bya/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar bya/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma thob pa rnams kyis thob par bya'o/ /de'i phyir du dus do nub nas bdud kyi gcod yul 'di nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /bla ma bka' rgyud dang bcas pa/ yid dam lha tshogs/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gal rkyen bar chad lam du slong bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bde sdug ro snyom par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lus kyi bdag 'dzin blos thongs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gcod yul mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam 'di la brten nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol byas la 'gro bar bya'o/ /gcod mkhan la la gsol ba 'di lta bu 'debs te/ sangs rgyas la chos la dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la chos la dge 'dun la brten no/ /bdag lung stong na 'dug gam/ re hrul lam phug gam/ gcong rong g.yang sa/ bla gab med pa na 'dug kyang rung ma 'dug kyang bsrung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ 'gal rkyen dang bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zer te de ni shin tu gol ba yin no/ /gcod kyi chos lugs dang 'gal ba yin pas mi 'thad de/ bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs ba'i 'jigs skyob kyi skyabs 'gro yin/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byas na/ gcod kyi gdams ngag med kyang bar chad mi 'ong ste/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ 'gro gang sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs 'gro ba/ /bdud rnams bye bas gsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs gyur kyang*/ /de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro /zhes pa dang*/ mdo rgyal mtshan dam pa las/ dge slong dag khyod dgon pa dang dur khrod dang shing drung dang bla gab med pa dang bas mtha' na 'dug pa na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su songs dang*/ 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal dang*/ spu zing zhes bya ba de med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de tsam 'jigs shing bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs na gnyan khrod na ma phyin pas chog ste/ de lta bu'i gcod mkhan de/ kha zas 'dod la zhe 'jigs pa wa mi ro la 'jab pa lta bu'i sgom chen pa yin no/ /nyams len de lta bu byed pa'i sgom chen gcod yul ba rnams ni lag pa g.yas pas khyi ro bsha' g.yon pas sel byed pa bya ba yin gsungs so/ /gnas po bdud la bcol bas gnas med gzhi mgron gcig tu 'dres/ /skyel ma dgra la bcol bas 'jigs med btsan sar thar/ /nad pa 'dre la bcol bas nad med bde bar 'tsho/ /lam khyer rkyen la byas pas mi mthun 'gal rkyen bral/ /zhes pa ni gnyan sa de ru slebs nas/ nyams len 'di ltar bya'o/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus ngag yid gsum la bdag tu bzung gces par bzung bas gnas skabs su 'dre dang gdon bgegs gnod 'tshe dang sdug bsngal 'byung*/ mthar thug tu khams gsum du 'khyams shing rigs drug tu 'khor/ de bdag 'dzin gyis len pa yin/ de ni nga'i lus sngon gyi las las grub pa/ rkyen pho mo'i 'dod chags kyis bskyed/ 'bras bu dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob dbang po sgo lnga tshang*/ phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad tshang ba'i bdag lus mdzes shing gtsang ba yid du 'ong*/ gces shing 'phangs pa/

dgos shing mkho ba'i lus 'di/ spyir 'gro drug sems can gyi don du gtong*/ sgos su drin can pha ma'i don du gtong ngo*/ /yang sgos 'dre khyed tsho'i gzan la ster bas ring na grang mor zo/ mi ring na tshos la zo/ zhen pa til gyi 'bru tsam yang mi byed do/ /su 'dod pa des khyer cig byas la lus la chags zhen mi bya bar mchil snabs bzhin du bor la bzhag /mdze ro bzhin du bor la btang*/ phyi sa bzhin du spangs la btang*/ sa rdo bzhin du bdag 'dzin med par bzhag pas/ 'dre dang gdon bgegs rnams kyis hab thob byas nas sha zos/ khrag btungs/ nang rol mid/ rus pa 'chos/ dbang po lnga khyer lhag ma til 'bru tsam yang ma lus par bsgoms la/ lus dngos po can de ni khyed tshos zos/ sems stong pa nyid la ni dngos po mi 'dug pas/ da nga la bdag 'dzin dang gces 'dzin bya dgos pa mi 'dug /nya ra bya rgyu mi 'dug /lus kyi kha ta dang*/ gnyer kha dgos pa mi 'dug snyam pa'i ngang du lhod de 'jog pa yin/ gcod mkhan phal cher lus mi gtsang ba'i phung po rnag khrag gi rkyal ba/ ngar snabs kyi phung po 'di/ bdag la dgos pa med pas su 'dod pa khyer cig zer te/ de la ni skyon bzhi yod pas mi 'thad de/ gcig tu zhe reng nas sbyin par gtong na ma dag pa'i sbyin par 'gro bas tshogs mi rdzogs/ gnyis su bdag la ma mkho ba zhig 'dre la byin yang mi phan te kho la'ang mi mkho/ gsum du 'dres lus khyer du byung gis dogs nas rna dgag tu 'gro /bzhi par lus de mi gtsang ba'i thum po yin no byas pas 'dre zhen pa log nas mi 'dod du re ba'i phyir yin pas mi 'thad do/ /de ru nyams len ni gnas po bdud la g.yar ba/ skyel ma dgra la 'chol ba/ bu rdzi 'dre la 'chol bar bya ste/ gnas po bdud la g.yar bas gzhi mgron gcig tu 'dres pa ni/ gnyan pa'i sa der phyin nas gzhi bdag de la nga 'di ru lus skyel du 'ong nas yod pas/

da khyod rang ci byed pa gyis shig byas pas bdag 'dzin thongs ba'i dgos pa yod/ gzhi bdag des mi gnod kyi steng du/ phan thog ste gzhan gyi gnod pa zhar la khos srung zhing sgrub pa po'i srung ma ru 'gro ba yin no/ /de ltar 'gro ba'i re ba ni mi bya ste/ byas na snyems byed kyi bdud 'jug go /dper na yul gang du phyin yang gnas po de mgron po'i phyogs su yong ba dang 'dra ste/ bsrung du gsol bskyab tu gsol khyed rang shes so mi zer ro/ /skyel ma dgra la 'chol ba ni/ dgra la dgra ru bzung nas zon byas pas gnod pa skyel ba yin gyi/ dgra ru ma bzung zon ma byas na kho rang can du babs nas kho rang gis mi gnod kyi steng du gzhan gyis gnod pa'ang khos srung ba dang skyel ma byed pa bzhin 'dre gang gnod de rang la 'dre ru ma bzung zon ma byas par nyal nas bsdad pas kho la do mi bdo/ gnod pa mi skyel brnyas pa mi byed/ lus ster du 'ongs pa yin/ za 'am mi za khyod rang shes byas pas/ gnod pa kho rang gis mi byed/ byed pa tsho khos bsrung ngo*/ /nad pa 'dre la gtad pa ni/ nad pa'i sngas srung byed pa dang*/ bu chung sri'u gso na/ 'di ltar bya ste/ bu chung dang nad pa la gang gnod pa'i 'dre 'di na gnas bya ba yod na/ de'i tshang de ru nad pa dang bu chung khyer nas 'gro /de ma grub na/ gnod pa'i 'dre de tshur la bos la nad pa de byin nas/ thag ge zos par bsgom/ de ltar byas pas bu chung dang nad pa 'dre las dgra ru che ba med pa la de mgu bar byas pas/ nad pa'i lan chags dang bu lon 'khor/ 'dre yid ches kho thag chod nas kho rang yang gnod pa mi byed/ gzhan gyis gnod pa'ang srung skyob byed do/ /de ni lam khyer rkyen la byed pa'i gdams ngag yin te/ dper na btsan dug la bcud len byas na/ 'go nad gnyan nad klu'i gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phyis dug gi nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa bzhin no/

/yang tshoms las/ nad dang nad pa 'dre dang gsum/ /gnyis med stong pa'i ngang la bzhag /lus po gtub la tshogs su 'bul/ /rnam rtog chos nyid gter du sba/ /de yang lan grangs mang du bya/ /sos na dga' ba'i sems mi bskyed/ /ces so/ /phung po gzan du bskyur bas gces 'dzin blo dang bral/ /lus sems sor sor bral bas bdag 'dzin mkhan po stor/ /'jigs mkhan rtsa brdar bcad pas nyam nga rang sar yal/ /lus kyi bdag 'dzin bral bas bar chad dpal du shar/ /zhes pa ni gnyan sa de ru phyin nas/ khres se nyal la phung po gzan du skyur ba ni/ bdag tu bzung ba'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha 'dre'i gzan du bskyur/ thed la bor te ci dga' ba gyis su bzhag la/ gces par 'dzin pa'i blo dang phral nas 'gro'o/ /lus sems gnyis po so sor phral nas lus sbyin par btang*/ zhen na sems stong ba'i ngang du bzhag pas bdag 'dzin dang gces 'dzin gyi mkhan po stor 'gro ste/ dper na dur khrod kyi mi ro la lus sems bral bas bdag 'dzin mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /'jigs mkhan rtsa brdar bcad pas nyams nga rang sar yal nas 'gro ba ni nam 'jigs pa'i tshe 'jigs mkhan de spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar du/ sha la 'dug gam rus pa la 'dug gam/ khrag la 'dug gam/ phyi na 'dug gam nang na 'dug gam lta/ gru bzhi nar mo sgor mo zur sum zlum po sog kha sogs/ gzugs ci 'dra 'dug lta/ kha dog dkar po nag po ser po dmar po ljang khu/ ngur smrig sogs ji ltar 'dug lta/ lus 'jigs pa yin na ni/ sbyin par btang zin pas med/ sems 'jigs pa yin na ni stong par 'dug /da gang la 'jigs/ ci la 'jigs snyam du bsam/ de ltar btsal bas ma rnyed tsa na/ nyam nga bag tsha thams cad rang grol la 'gro /de ltar na 'gal rkyen bar chad na tsha sdug bsngal thams cad bdag 'dzin yod pas lan pa yin/ /bdag 'dzin bral bas sa rdo dang khyad med de/ 'jigs don med/

yang tshoms las/ lus ni ro yi tshul du bzhag /bdag po med pa'i tshul du bzhag /res 'ga' mi mgo skam po bzhin/ sgo lnga rgya yan har por bzhag /ces so/ de ltar rtogs na bdud dpal du 'char/ bar chad dngos grub tu 'byung ngo*/ rkyen la rkyang 'ded byas pas bar chad stong par zhi/ / gdon la spar 'dzin byas pas 'jigs yul stong par rtogs/ /thams cad sems su shes pas 'dzin med rang sar grol/ /gang dgar bskyur nas btang na sus kyang 'khyer mi srid/ /zhes pa ni/ 'gal rkyen dang bar chad cho 'phrul ci byung yang*/ gnad bzhi pa 'di bya ste/ rkyen la rkyang 'ded bya ba/ gdon la spar zin bya ba/ thams cad sems su shes pa/ gang dgar bskyur ba dang bzhi'o/ /bzhi po de nyams su blangs te/ rkyen la rkyang 'ded bya ba ni/ gnas gang 'jigs pa de ru nyal/ dus nub mo la sogs pa nam 'jigs pa'i tshe/ rten lder so'am ro'am bra ma la sogs gang 'jigs pa de'i rtsa ru sdod pa'o/ /gdon la spar zin byed pa ni/ dngos sam nyams snang rmi lam la sogs par mig gis mthong ba'i gzugs can du byung na/ de la lag pas bzung la spar so 'thams la/ khyod nga'i zla la gtan du bzhugs par zhu byas la mi btang*/ nyams snang la byung na gsal gdab la de las gsal du btang la bya/ rmi lam du byung na/ da dung gnyid du song res la 'byon par zhu byas la'o/ /'bod du byung na/ a nga 'di na yod/ 'di ru shog cig bya'o/ /thams cad sems su sgom pa 'dre la lus byin rung*/ bsrungs rung yod par sgom rung med par sgom rung*/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba byung rung*/ dga' zhing bag dro ba byung rung*/ bred cing sngangs pa byung rung*/ blo bde ba 'jigs pa med pa byung rung*/ ci byung yang sems kyi cho 'phrul yid kyi ri mo rtog pa'i spro bsdu/ rig pa'i yo langs/ blos byas nyag gcig yin no/ /don la bden par grub pa spu'i rtse mo tsam zhig kyang med do/

/gang dgar bskyur la btang ba ni/ lus la nya ra dang bdag 'dzin/ gces 'dzin dang phangs sems/ chags pa dang zhen pa'i 'khris med par bskyur la btang ba'o/ /de ltar byas na/ sus kyang 'khyer mi srid/ 'dod pa su yang mi yong ngo*/ /dper na bung zas za ba la/ che na mi za/ ma byin na blang ba dang 'dra ste mi 'dod pa bzhin no/ /gang tshe chos nyid la ni mnyam par su bzhag pa/ /de ni bdud tshogs mi bzod cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /phyi nang gsang ba mngon sum nyams snang rmi lam du/ /sna tshogs gzugs ston mi snyan sna tshogs lung ston 'gyur/ /ces pa ni gdon bslangs ba'i rtags yin te/ de la gsum slong mi slong gi rgyu mtshan/ bslangs ba'i rtags/ bdud kyi gtse ba bstan pa'o/ / dang po ni gnyan sa der phyin nas nyams len gyi ngang du nyal bsdad pas gdon de'i nus pa ci yod pa de/ rab zhag gsum bsdad pas slong/ 'bring lnga'am bdun na slong/ tha ma'ang bcu na cis kyang slong pa yin no/ /mi slong pa dang slong tshabs chung ba dang slong 'phyi ba'i rgyu mtshan ni bying chung nas ldang ma nus pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa nus pa che bas zil gyis mnan nas ldang ma nus pa dang*/ yang gdon byings ches rnal 'byor pa nus pa chung nas ma bslangs pa dang*/ gcod yun thung nas ma bslangs pa dang*/ lugs mang du yod pas gang yin shes par bya'o/ /bdag nus pa chung na mi bslang stai/ sprang po lkog tu nyal ba dang*/ zhing pas lo srung ba dang*/ tshong pa mtshan 'gros byed pa dang*/ 'brog pa phyugs ma stor ba 'tshol ba dang*/ rkun ma nam la rku ru 'gro ba rnams ni nus pa med pas mi bslangs pa yin/ 'dre la do mi bsdo ba dang*/ kho rang la skyabs su 'gro ba dag kho yod pa'i gnas de ru nyal na'ang mi bslang pa yin/ gnas de ru phyin pa dang 'jigs la zhag tu lon gyin je mi 'jigs la song na gdon chung bas slong pa sla/ gdon tshan chung cho 'phrul chung non pa sla dbang du 'dus kyang yon tan chung*/

dang po mi 'jigs pa nyams dga' bar byung yang yun du bsdad zhag tu lon gyin je 'jigs la song nyams je mi dga' la song na gdon che bas slong dka'/ tshan che cho 'phrul che ba non na yon tan che ba yin no/ /lar yang staing gdon slong pa sla/ 'og gdon slong dka'/ lha khang dang khang stong la sogs pa dang por nyams nga cho 'phrul che yang non pa sla/ chu mig dang mtsho la sogs pa la dang po nyam dga' cho 'phrul chung yang non pa dka'/ rnal 'byor pa lta ba gdeng dang ldan pa'i sngags pa lha'i rnal 'byor sgom pa dang*/ gang zag rang la 'dre gdon gnod pa dang*/ sems la khu 'phrig yod pa rnams kyis zhag gcig na slong pa yod/ slong pa dang non pa dang*/ tshar tshad zhag gcig na 'byung ba'ang yod do/ /srod la cho 'phrul byung nas tho rangs tshar ba'i rigs kyang yod do/ /sngar nub cho 'phrul byung nas phyir nub tshar ba'i rigs dang lugs mang du yod do/ /phal cher zhag gsum dgos pa mang du 'byung ngo*/ /slong ma bslangs kyi rgyu mtshan yang*/ bslangs pa'i rtags la gsum ste/ phyi rtags lha 'dre bslangs pa'i rtags/ nang rnam rtog bslangs pa'i rtags/ bar na tsha bslangs pa'i rtags so/ /dang po gnyan sa de ru phyin nas/ lus sems phral te/ lus po yan par lhang gis bor/ sems nyam nga med pa/ bag tsha med pa rtog pa med pa/ snyems med pa rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du bzhag /'bol le shig ge lhan ner bzhag pas/ de'i byin rlabs dang chos nyid kyi gzi brjid mi bzod/ stong pa nyid kyi nus pa mi bzod do/ /rnal 'byor pa'i nyams len ma bzod par cho 'phrul sna tshogs 'byung ste/ che shos mig yul du mi sdug pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston te/ stag dang seng ger sprul nas za tshul ston/ khyi dang lce spyang dang dom du sprul nas rmug tshul ston/ glang dang g.yag tu sprul nas brdung tshul ston/ sbal sbrul sdom dang sdig pa la sogs pa'i sems can 'jigs par sprul nas 'jigs skrag dang bred sngangs ston/

dgra dang skyes pa dang bud med du sprul nas mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te 'ded tshul ston/ brdung tshul ston/ 'khyig tshul ston/ 'dzin du 'ong ba dang*/ mngon du 'ong ba dang*/ rbab tu sgril ba dang*/ mgo gzhug zlog pa dang*/ mal sa de nas gzhan du skyel ba dang*/ ma dang sring mo dang bud med mdzes mar sprul nas chags pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang*/ 'dzum zhing slu brid ston pa dang*/ pha dang spun dang grogs por sprul nas ngu ba dang*/ cho nge 'debs pa dang*/ drag po'i sgra mi snyan pa'i nga ro sgrog pa'o/ /mkhan po dang slob dpon du sprul nas khyod kyi chos nor/ lam log pa yin zer ba dang*/ khyod kyi tshe de ring las med zer ba dang*/ da lta'i zhag brgya na khyod 'chi zer ba dang*/ khyod shi ma thag tu dmyal bar skye zer ba dang*/ gzugs med pa'i bshud pa tser tser 'bud pa dang*/ rna bar rgyob cig sod cig zer ba la sogs pa rab la mngon sum du 'ong*/ 'bring la nyams snang du 'ong ba dang*/ tha ma rmi lam du 'ong ba'o/ /cho 'phrul 'bring po la me 'bar ba dang*/ chus 'khyer ba dang*/ rbab sgril ba dang*/ gad pa sdib pa dang*/ brag zhig pa dang sa g.yo ba dang*/ sa gzhi thams cad 'dar phril phril 'ong ba dang*/ 'gul 'gul ldeg ldeg 'ong ba dang*/ 'ur chom dang 'ur sgra dang*/ ldeg pa dper na mi yod pa snyam byed pa dang*/ gdong pa tsha 'ub 'ub yong ba dang*/ rgyab nas tsha 'ur te rdeg pa dang*/ gos dang skra nas 'then 'then byed pa dang*/ rtsa ru rdo dang bong ba rdi ri ri skyur ba dang*/ ming nas lhang tser 'bod pa la sogs pa'o/ /cho 'phrul tha ma la/ lus po rtse sil ba dang*/ shes pa skyi bung ba dang*/ sna ru sgog dri'am gsur dri/ bya rgod spos la sogs pa'i dri mi zhim pa rnams 'ga' 'byung*/ rmi lam du'ang ston pa yin pas khang pa sgo med du chud pa dang*/ brag dang gad pa'i kha nas rbab du 'chor ba dang*/ chus khyer ba dang*/

khang pa rdib pa dang chu chen po'i kha nas zam pa ldem ldem pa la phyin nas lhung la khad pa dang*/ mdor na rmi lam the tshom dang rnam rtog skye ba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston du 'ong bas/ de'i dus su rmi lam na'ang nyam nga med na mchog yin/ rmi lam du nyam nga dag byung na'ang*/ bdud kyi nyams tshad yin pas/ gnyid sad pa nas rmi lam bzang ngan rtog dpyod ma gtong bar nyam nga bag tsha med par nyams len gyi thog tu bzhag pas nyams dga' ya ler 'gro/ blo bde 'bol ler 'gro /bag dro 'ur re 'gro /cho 'phrul gyi rtog pa de zhi nas nyams mi 'dra ba gsar pa zhig skye ba yin no/ /cho 'phrul byung ba'i dus su/ de nyid du gnyen pos ma zin yang*/ de'i rting la rjes snyegs su gnyen po btang la/ nyam nga med/ bag tsha med/ snyems med 'jigs pa tsam du'ang grub pa med par shes pa rang sar glod la bzhag /de ltar byas pas bdud dpal du 'char/ rkyen grogs su 'char/ bar chad dngos grub tu 'char ba yin no/ / cho 'phrul de rnams ni nyams len byas na dus gzhan du'ang 'byung srid/ lhag par gcod byed pa'i dus su 'byung ngo*/ /nang rnam rtog slong ba'i rtags ni/ rang gi rgyud la khams 'dus dang*/ snying rlung dang*/ snying mi dga' ba dang*/ don med pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ sems skyo ba dang*/ 'gro snying 'dod pa dang*/ zla bo dang 'grogs snying 'dod pa dang*/ shes pa phyi sangs khyer/ tshig pa za/ khams mi bde/ gcod kyi nyams len byed par 'tsher/ byed snying mi 'dod/ rnam rtog sna tshogs 'char/ nyon mongs pa rags po 'byung bas/ nyams len gsang sngags bzhin byas pas/ de thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul/ nam mkha'i ri mo/ rnam rtog gi gzugs brnyan/ yid kyis bzo byas yin pas/ skye med rang grol/ dran med stong pa/ gtad med/ bden med/ 'gyu ba dngos med du shes par gyis la/ rang yal rang grol du 'gro ba yin no/ /bar na tsha bslangs pa'i rtags ni lus la chu thor dang*/

skrang 'bur sha 'phrig /sha 'gul glang shu/ me dbal/ bal 'dogs/ lhog pa gzer nad la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /sna re tsam 'byung ba yod de/ de byung ba dang ma byung ba gnyis ka la dga' mi dga' gang yang mi bya bar/ nyam nga bag tsha med par sems gzhi med ngang du glod la/ ci yong ba shog ci dga' bar gyis/ gar 'gro bar song snyam du byas la bzhag go /bdud kyi gtse ba ston pa ni/ gcod byed pa'i dus sam dus gzhan du'ang 'byung ba srid de/ bdud kyi gtse ba bcu drug la sogs 'byung ngo*/ gtse ba bcu drug ni/ gya nom gyi gtse ba bzhi/ the tshom spyad pa'i gtse ba bzhi/ 'jigs shing skrag pa'i gtse ba bzhi/ cho 'phrul gyi gtse ba bzhi'o/ /dang po ni khyod skal pa mang po nas tshogs bsags pa yin pas/ lo 'di tsam zhig na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams 'di skad bya bar sangs rgyas te/ gdul bya 'di tsam 'byung*/ phrin las 'di tsam zhig 'byung ngo*/ /zhes yid dga' bar byed/ sems dpang mtho bar byed/ nga rgyal dang rlom pa/ dregs pa skye bar byed/ da sangs rgyas zin gyi sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ /tshul khrims kyis ci zhig bya zer ba dang*/ da khyod bsgom mi dgos pas lam gyi 'bad rtsol spongs shig zer nas/ dge ba las blo log tu 'jug pa dang*/ da khyod 'bras bu thob zin gyi/ 'dod yon spyad pas chog pa'i dus yin gyis 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug la ci dga' bar spyod cig /ces bya ba ma yin pa la spyod du 'jug pa dang*/ 'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa 'di rnams yang dag pa yin pas/ dga' ba dang mgu ba dang*/ rang par gyis/ sems gzengs bstod la gzhan la'ang rgya cher ston pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang sgrogs shig zer ba 'byung ngo*/ /'jigs pa skye ba'i gtse ba bzhi ni khyod kyi pha mes bdun nas kyi 'chi ba'i gshed ma nga yin pas/ khyod rang ngas za bar byed zer ba dang*/ khyod kyi bla ma brgyud pa thams cad sku tshe ngas bstungs pa yin no/

/srog len nga yin no zer ba dang*/ 'o skol gyi yi dam kho'i rkang pa'i 'og tu mnan chos skyong gi mgul nas bzung ste/ khyod kyi lha dang srung ma la'ang*/ 'khos 'khyer 'di las med par khyod la nus pa ci la yod zer ba dang*/ rang gi lhar sprul nas khyod skyob par mi nus kyi slar kho la skyabs su songs shig /zer nas 'jigs shing skrag par byed/ bred cing sngangs bar byed/ sems 'phang dma' bar byed/ nyam nga ba spu zing byed du 'jug pa'o/ /the tshom skye ba'i gtse ba bzhi ni rang gi yi dam du sprul nas khyod kyi lam de log pa yin/ khyod kyis bskal bar bsgrubs kyang mi 'grub zer nas the tshom skye ru 'jug pa dang*/ rang gi bla mar sprul nas buu 'u cag dpon slob kyi chos 'di nor nas 'dug /ngas de nyams su blangs pas bskal pa mang por dmyal bar skyes/ chos des nga bslus 'dug khyod rang lta sgom spyod pa de bor la/ de min pa'i chos gzhan zhig nyams su longs shig /zer ba dang khyod chos 'di nyams su blangs na skal ba 'di tsam zhig dmyal bar skye zer ba dang*/ bla ma yi mos gus dang*/ stong nyid snying rje la sogs pa'i chos 'di ni yang dag pa'i lam ma yin pas spongs shig zer ba dang*/ sems the tshom du byed/ som nyi ru byed/ yid gnyis su byed de/ rnam rtog skye ru 'jug pa'o/ /cho 'phrul gyi gtse ba bzhi ni/ rang gi snying dmar tsa re bton nas song ba snyam byed pa dang*/ don snying brul nas byung ba snyam byed pa dang*/ lus la ga can gzan dang srin po/ gnod sbyin sha zas dngos su za ba dang*/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ sa gas nas khyod 'di nas mar lhung nas dmyal bar skye'o zer ba la sogs pa'i bdud kyi gtse ba bcu drug gcod byed pa'i dus sam/ dus gzhan dag tu yang 'byung srid de/ gsang sngags pas bzhed pa'i rtsa dang rlung gi byed pas khams 'dus pa dang po'i dus kyi nyams snang du 'dod de/

nang de ltar myong yang phyi na ni bden par grub pa gcig kyang med de/ mdang gi rmi lam bzhin du'o/ /gcod yul ba'i 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i ting 'dzin gyi drod nyul ba yin pas/ dge sbyor la nyams sad byed par 'dod do/ /de gnyis ka gang du 'dod kyang phung po gzan du bskyur ba/ lus sems so sor dbral ba/ 'jigs mkhan rtsa brdar bcad pa/ lus kyi bdag 'dzin spang ba dang bzhi bya ste/ cho 'phrul byung na nyams len gyi steng du bzhag pa ni/ de la bden par bzung*/ dogs pa byas/ skyon du bltas na/ bar chad du 'gyur bas/ de'i ngo bo gsog gsob ya ma brla/ snying po med pa yin pas/ sems kyis de la rtog pa dang bden pa dang dngos por mi bzung*/ rtog pa mi bya/ gtad med bden med kyi ngang du 'jog go /sems la khu 'phrig byung na 'dzin pa yul nas thon/ /nang 'dre rang sems brtul na phyi 'dre stong par yal/ /mi phod mi nus byung na mgo snyoms thog rdzis bya/ /nyam nga bag tsha byung na rnam rtog ar la gtad/ /ces pa ni/ gcod log pa'i rgyu bzhi yod de/ sems la khu 'phrig byung ba/ rang snang 'dre ru langs pa/ nyams len mi nus mi phod pa/ nyam nga bag tsha 'byung ba'o/ /dang po ni sngon ngo sprod ma thebs pas rang sems stong par ma shes/ gdam ngag gi thos pa chung bas 'khor 'das sems su ma rtogs/ nyams rtogs kyi dpa' rtsal med pas gnyan sar 'gro mi nus/ lus kyi bdag 'dzin ma thongs pas phung po gzan du bskyur ma nus/ snying rus kyi gcod khams chung bas 'gal rkyen dang bsre ma phod/ sdug bsran dang zhe bcad chung bas gcod 'phro bzhag pa/ le lo dang g.yeng ba che bas gcod mthar ma phyin pa dang*/ bdun po des dang po gcod la 'gro mi nus pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du ldog pa'i rkyen byed/ tha mar tshar tshad yong ba'i gegs byed do/ /gcod 'phro bzhag pa dang brel nas gnyan sa der nyal ma khom na/ de ru mal bca' ba'am tho brtsig pa'am/

phyi sa bor la bzhag go /rang snang 'dre ru langs pa ni/ nang 'dres phyi 'dre g.yab pa yin te/ phyi na 'dre yod ma myong yang nang na 'drer 'dzin gyi blo yod pas gcod la phyin nas/ gnyan khrod du nyal te bsdad pas phyi'i 'dre ma byung yang 'drer rtog skyes nas/ thug zer yang 'dre yin nam snyam/ shog zer yang dang brtsig pa zhig pa dang*/ rdo dang bong ba 'dril ba dang*/ gad pa rdib pa dang*/ brag zhig pa dang*/ shing 'dab rlung gis khyer ba dang*/ spyang ki ri dwags wa sprel gyi rgyu 'grul sogs ci dang ci byung yang 'dre yin nam snyam pa de ni/ rang snang 'dre ru langs pa bya ba yin/ dper na ka ra bu ram dang sbrang rtsi la kha ba yod ma myong yang nang na/ gcong nad na ba des mngar gsum zos na kha gyog ge 'ong ste/ nang gi rang skyon yin pa/ de bzhin du gcod byed pa la snang ba 'dre snang du ma song ba zhig dgos pa yin no/ /mi phod mi nus pa ni/ zas nor gtong mi phod/ chos byed mi nus pa la sogs pa yin la/ gcod kyi dus su dang po gnyan sa der 'gro mi phod/ shi mi phod/ lus srog gtong mi phod/ tshar tshad ma byung gi bar du sdod mi nus pa'o/ /yang tshoms las/ skyid la 'bral bar mi phod dang*/ /sdug la gcod par mi phod dang*/ /gnyan sa 'grim par mi phod dang*/ /nad dang 'dre la sogs pa la/ /mi phod bzhin du thog rdzis bya zhes so/ /nyam nga bas gnyan khrod du nyal tsa na/ nyam nga bag tsha/ 'jigs pa dang skrag pa byed pa sngangs bar byed pa la sogs pa 'ong ste/ de la nyam nga med par byas nas tshugs par byed dgos so/ /nyam nga ba la sogs pa de rnams ma byung ba la/ bzang rgyu med dga' rgyu med do/ /ngo mtshar che rgyu med do/ /de rnams byung bas gcod ma byung bar mi 'gro /de rnams la 'jigs te ma tshugs par log nas 'ong na gcod ma byung bar yang 'gro la/ zla ba phyed tshun chad gzer dang pho glang la sogs pa'i bar chad yong bas/

rab lta ba rtogs pa'i ngang du nyal nas bsdad/ 'bring blos byas kyi lta thog tu bzhag /tha ma sdug bsran dang gnyen po bskyed la/ na mod shi mod gang yong ba shog snyam pa'i steng du bskyur ro/ /hril gyis dril na/ lus ster nus pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /ar la gtad pa ni/ thog rdzis byas nas 'dre dngos med kyi ngang du sems chos nyid du yal nas 'gro'o/ /'jigs rgyu gtad med dang 'jigs mkhan gtad med du grol 'gro'o/ /de'i dus su log non dang*/ mtha' la gtad pa la sogs mi bya bar sngar gyi thabs des nyams su blang ngo*/ /thabs gang gis kyang ma non na/ log non dang mtha' gtad la 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /rkyen bag tsam re la mi bya dang po rang nas mi bya/ ci nas kyang ma non ma lhong na byed pa yin no/ /cho 'phrul che nas ma zug gcod 'phro bcad pa dang*/ /'gyod dang the tshom lta log chos kyis sun pa dang*/ /na tsha sdug bsngal khams 'dus nyams len stor ba rnams/ /log rtog bar chod byung bas 'bad rtsol bton la sgrubs zhes pa ni/ log pa'i rgyus log pa'i rtags ni/ phyi rtags cho 'phrul 'char ba/ nang rtags sems la 'char ba/ gsang rtags lus la 'char ba'o/ /dang po ni mngon sum mam/ nyams snang ngam/ rmi lam du cho 'phrul dang*/ gdug rtsub che drag nas ma tshug pa dang thabs gang byas kyang ma phan pa'o/ /de ltar byung na mal chen po gcig bcas la/ 'di ru 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di ma stong bar du sdod pa yin no/ /gdug rtsub dang cho 'phrul khyod rang nyin med mtshan med du ston cig sdod ma nus na nga zhan/ yong ma nus na khyod zhan/ ster ma nus na nga zhan/ za ma nus na khyod zhan/ cho 'phrul tsam la bzhag mi dgos dngos su yongs nas hab hab zos pas chog /nga 'bros ni mi 'bros/ bsrung ni mi bsrung*/ yib ni mi yib/ 'thab ni mi 'thab/ gang byed pa byas pas chog ces ngag tu'ang brjod/ yid la'ang bsam/ /nang rtags sems la 'char ba ni/

gcod la 'ongs pa 'gyod nas dang po rang ma yong pa yin na snyam pa dang*/ bla mas kyang 'di 'dra'i chos shig nga la 'bogs pa zhan snyam pa dang*/ 'di rang gis sangs rgyas sam mi rgyas snyam pa dang*/ log non gyi gdams ngag ci bsten yang des phan thogs med de/ da ni cang med ci byas kyang mi phan/ kho rgyal ba yin snyam pas/ yid ma ches nas thabs la log par mthong*/ chos la yid ma ches/ nyams len gyis sun/ gcod byed snying mi 'dod/ gcod la 'gro ba 'tsher/ gzhan du 'gro snying 'dod/ zla bo snying la 'dod/ snying mi dga'/ sems 'gro rjes khyer/ rig pa phya sangs khyer/ bag ma phebs nyin mo nyi ma rgas dus med/ mtshan mo nam la langs dus med/ nyi ma phyi dro red nas shes pa 'phyo/ grib so 'ubs se byung ba dang*/ rig pa phyal lang ste 'gro /sa tshub be song ba dang 'jigs shum byed/ skyi bung nge 'gro/ mgo lpags sra thang nge 'gro /mi'am 'dre la sogs pa zing nge 'dzin du 'ong snyam byed pa dang*/ 'bud de 'thab tu 'ong snyam byed pa dang*/ habs se za ru 'ong snyam byed pa dang*/ skad 'don mi nus/ krong krong mi nus mal tshig za/ gnyid mi 'ong*/ lus la rngul yong*/ shes pa dpangs dma'/ rig pa ngar chag pa la sogs pa 'byung srid de/ de rnams ni lha 'dres zil gyis non pa'i rtags yin no/ /de'i dus su phaṭa byas la/ cir snang rang rig gi cho 'phrul/ gang shar rnam rtog gi ri mo/ ci byung rang sems kyi yo langs su 'dug pa/ 'dre khyod pas snang srid lha srin dgrar langs kyang*/ snyems sems kyang mi byed do/ /ro stod steng gi lha brgyad khyer/ ro smad 'og gi klu brgyad khyer/ nang rol sde dpon bcwo brgyad khyer/ don snying lha srin sde brgyad khyer/ dbang po snang srid lha srin thams cad khyer/ nga a pho rgad po la dbang ba til 'bru tsam yang mi gda'o/ /chags zhen rdul tsam yang mi gda'o byas la lus dngos med sems stong nyid/

rtog pa btsan chod kyi ngang du 'bol le bzhag go /de tsho byung nas log non dang mtha' la gtad pa la sogs pa'i thabs gzhan gang yang mi dgos so/ /de rang gi ngang la ma bcos par bzhag pas chog gsungs so/ / gsang rtags lus la 'char ba ni/ na tsha drag po byung ba dang*/ skrangs 'bur dang gzer drag po lang pa dang*/ shu ba dang thab thor byung ba dang*/ glang shu bas 'dog byung ba dang*/ rkyen bag tsam re la bred sngangs byung ba dang*/ shes pa 'tshub cing snying 'khrug pa dang*/ don med par blo mi bde ka re 'ong ba dang rngul 'bab/ shug ring 'don snying 'dod pa dang 'khru ba dang skyug pa la sogs pa byung nas na bas so/ /gang byung na'ang lus la gces 'dzin gcig kyang mi bya/ dus rgyun du lus ster ba'i blo dang ma bral bar bya/ gnod pa'i gdon de rnams mdun du byung ste lus po mi la so so'i mgo bo stag dang dom dang g.yag glang spyang ki /phag pa/ khyi/ sdig pa/ sbrul gyi mgo la sogs pa byas nas rang gi lus po 'di la las mgo nas mar za/ la las rkang pa nas yar za/ la las dbus nas za/ la las don snying dang nang rol za/ la las lpags pa bshu/ la las sha za/ la las khrag 'thung*/ la las rus pa 'cha' bar bsgom/ lus sha kham gcig khrag thigs pa gcig /skra nyag ma gcig kyang ma lus par khong tshos zos so/ /'grang zhing tshims te rang rang so so'i gnas su 'gro snying 'dod pa tsho gyes/ sdod snying 'dod pa tshos bdag gi mtha' bskor nas 'dug par bsgom/ de ni phung po rnam dag gi mchod pa/ snang srid gzhir bzhengs kyi tshogs gsogs/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi sbyin pa/ de kho na nyid kyi tshogs 'khor bdag nyid chen po'i ston mo zhes bya ste/ dmyal bar ltung yang de bas thu ba bya sa med/ da ci yong ba shog snyam par bya'o/ /de ni gcod byed pa'i dus ma gtogs pa dus nam byas kyang tshogs gsogs kyi mthar thug /sbyin pa gtong ba'i mchog /rim gro rkyen zlog gi gtso bo yin no/

/log chen mtha' la gtad pas re dogs rang sar grol/ /theg chen zil gyis mnan pas bde sdug gtan la phebs/ /skar chen theb 'og bcugs pas 'khor 'das rdzun khung rdib/ /gnyan sar gnyan thog dbab pas lha 'dre sgyu mar zhig /ces pa ni dang po gnyan khrod du phyin la/ gcad thabs kyi gdams ngag nyams su blang*/ de la bslangs na slong rtags nas bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /de las ldog byung na ldog rtags nas bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /gang gis kyang ma phan par log chen po byung na log chen mtha' la gtad par bya ste/ don go log chen mtha' la gtad pa 'di yin/ lag len gnyan thog tu gnyan dbab pa yin/ dgos pa theg chen chos kyi zil gyis gnon pa/ skar chen thebs 'og tu bcug pa dang 'dra ba 'di nyams su blang ngo*/ /de la gsum ste phyi rkyen mtha' la gtad pa/ bar phung po mtha' la gtad pa/ nang 'dzin pa mtha' la gtad pa'o/ /dang po klu'am btsan nam bdud dam sngar nas gnod pa'i lha 'dre'am/ gcod byas nas ma chod pa'i rkyen langs pa la sogs/ gzhan bas gnyan pa cho 'phrul che ba/ gdug rtsub che ba gcad par gang dka' ba'i gnas de ru phyin la gcad par bya ste/ gnyan thog tu gnyan dbab pa ni/ nad thog tu me btsa' 'debs pa dang 'dra ste dper na sman pas nad thog tu me btsa' btab pas/ dmigs la song na tag tse zer nas yal 'gro /de bzhin du gnyan sa de'i ltag tu nyal nas bsdad pas lha 'dre des ma bzod par zing nge langs nas 'ong*/ de'i dus su sgom chen nyams kyi nyams tshan skyed/ nyams rtogs kyi rtogs tshan skyed/ snying rus kyi sdod tshan bskyed nas nyal bsdad pas/ khos glags ma rnyed par kho rang bros 'gro ste/ dper na khyi srang phugs su bcur ba 'dra bas/ gal te tshur la zings tsam zhig 'ong mi 'ong yin/ kho rang bred nas bros 'gro /brtag pa mkhan po'i bzhed pas/ de las ldog yong bar 'dod la/ gcod kyi lung gis 'dre gdon yul nas thon par 'dod/

des na gcod 'di gdon thog tu 'gro bas mdze gso ba'i mchog yin no/ /bar phung po mtha' la gtad pa ni cho 'phrul che zhing gcad par dka' ba de ru phyin la thag pa nag po gcig la se bcings byas la/ de rang gi ske la bcug ste/ lha khang yin na thag sna de lder tsho'i lag tu btang la bzhag /sdong po 'dug na de la btags/ brag gam pho brang ngam/ bra ma 'dug na de la btags la bzhag /ne'u sing ngam sko phug /thang chen yin na de'i dkyil du bal phur btsugs la de la btags la bzhag /chu mig 'dug na thag pa'i sne la rdo ba btags la de'i nang du bskyur la gang la gnas pa'i lha 'dre de la gtad do/ /nang du bdag 'dzin mtha' la gtad pa ni/ lus bzhis bsdus kyi phung po 'di ci tsug byas kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das/ gtan du mi sdod tshe thar du lus pa su'ang med pas/ nam yang lus gtong ba mnyam po la dus da lta kho 'dod cing rang la sbyin dbang yod dus 'dir ci ste mi gtong*/ spyir 'gro drug yongs kyi glud du gtong*/ sgos drin can pha ma'i don du gtong*/ yang dgos lha 'dre khyod kyi don du gtong bas/ gnod pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ snang srid lha ma srin sde brgyad/ gshin rje ma mo/ klu btsan/ bdud/ rgyal po/ pe dkar/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ gdon bgegs/ gri bo/ gri mo/ sa bdag yul lha/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad/ na rag dmyal khams yan gyi snang srid lha 'dre/ che dgu dregs dgu thams cad 'dir byon cig /bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lus bzhi bsdus kyi phung po 'di sha khrag gi rang bzhin/ rtsa rgyus kyi drwa ba/ mgo dang yan lag /sha khrag dang dbang po/ nang rol dang don snying*/ rkang mar dang tshil bu/ rus pa dang klad pa/ khams sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tshe dang dbugs/ srog dang lus 'di khyod tsho la ster bas/ ya mgal ya bdud rgyal pos khyer/ ma mgal ma bdud rgyal mos khyer/ pho gdon stod la dga' bas stod khyer/

mo gdon smad la dga' bas smad khyer/ pe kar rgyal po don snying la dga' bas/ klu dang sa bdag rtsa rgyus la dga' bas/ gri bo gri mo sha khrag la dga' bas/ bsre rags dam sri lpags pa la dga' bas/ gang la gang 'dod du ster bas/ khyed rnams tshim par gsol/ dgyes par rol/ mnyes par dgongs shig /ster ma nus na nga zhan/ za ma nus na khyod zhan no/ rab dam pa na/ lha 'dre khyed rnams kyis dmyal bar bskyur la gtan du thar du med par thong zhig /'bring du nga'i tshe do nub zo la nang par lang rgyu med pa zhig gyis shig

/tha ma'ang nga la mdze thongs/ skran thongs/ dmu chu thongs/ gting nad thongs/ snying rlung thongs/ khams 'dus thongs/ brgyal nad smyo 'bog thongs/ gag lhog thongs/ gnyan nad thongs la/ shi ma shi gson ma gson zhig thongs shig /ces ngag tu brjod do/ /yid la dmigs pa bsgom pa ni/ bdag la bar chad rtsom zhing gnod par byed pa'i lha 'dre'i gtsor byas pa'i 'byung po thams cad mdun du spyan drangs la/ de rnams mi sdug cing mi srun pa rang rang gi gzugs sna tshogs 'dzin par bsgoms la/ rang lus tha mal pa'i phung po 'di gtsang zhing mdzes pa/ tsho la dkar ba gcig tu bsgoms la/ a ba glang mgo /sdig pa sbrul mgo /yag sha phag mgo /gnod sbyin dom mgo can gyis gtsor byas pa'i snang srid lha 'dre thams cad kyis 'di dum brgya dum stong du gtubs te zos par bsgoms la/ thams cad kyis skal ba mnyam por thob ste/ lha 'dre re re'i lag tu lus re re dang mnyam pa'i bza' btung phun sum tshogs pa byas par bsgoms la/ sbyin pa btang la rig pa stong gsal 'dzin med kyi ngang du nyal la bsdad do/ /de ltar zhe rgyud la skyes na/ nad dang gdon dang bar chad gangagis kyang mi tshugs te/ gcig tu bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs pas/ lha 'dre rnams bar chad bya bar brtsams pa la 'gyod pa skye ba yin/ gnyis su snying rje bsgoms pas/ lha 'dre rnams kyi rgyud la lha 'dre rnams kyi bu tsha'i 'du shes 'char ba yin/ gsum du ting nge 'dzin gyis lus sbyin par btang bas/ lha 'dre rnams rgyud tshims nas 'gro ba yin/ bzhi ru lta ba rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas stong nyid ngang nas de ltar byas pas/ lha 'dre rnams dngos por 'dzin pa'i bden zhen la blo log nas 'gro ba yin/ lnga ru smon lam btabs pas/ de'i byin rlabs kyis lha 'dre rnams kyi rgyud chags sdang dang nyon mongs pa'i bsam pa las grol nas 'gro ba yin no/ /sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa la bkra shis tshe ring mas gtsor byas pa'i gdon chen bco brgyad kyis bar chad rtsom du 'ongs pas/

rje btsun gyis lus sbyin par btang*/ lta ba mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng khong du chud pas/ bar chad zhi nas de rnams dbang du 'dus pa dang*/ sras rgyal ba don 'grub la ban de mang pos mthu btang bas/ sras kyis ban de'i gtor stegs 'og tu nyal bas/ mthus ma tshugs par phar la log pa la sogs pa mang du yod do/ / yang lha 'dre'i rigs tshan gcig la de ltar byas pas ma bzod par yang na gus pas 'dud du 'ong*/ yang na cho 'phrul ston du 'ong ste/ ngu ba dang smre sngags 'don pa dang*/ 'o dod 'bod cho nge 'debs/ skad ngan chen po 'don pa dang*/ gzugs sna tshogs ston pa la sogs dngos sam nyams snang rmi lam du 'byung bas ci byung yang nyams len gyi thog tu bzhag pas chog go /bden par mi 'dzin rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu shes par bya ste/ mdo las/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par byed mthong yang*/ /de la lus med sems med ming yang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /nyams snang mthong snang rmi lam gang du shar yang 'khrul snang las ma 'das pas/ steng nas gnam rdib/ 'og nas mtsho rdol/ rgyab nas ri nyil/ mdun nas brag ral yang blo chos nyid kyi thog tu bzhag go /de thams cad rang grol la 'gro'o/ /rgyab nas khyis brad/ mdun nas byas btogs/ btsan dang bdud gnyis mtshon thogs nas g.yas g.yon gnyis na 'dug kyang*/ blo nyam nga med pa'i ngang du lhod de bzhag dang de thams cad rang yal du 'gro'o/ /bdud nag po mgo dgu pa zhig gis gnya' ltag nas zhon te ske bregs/ snying bton/ da lta nyid du gsod pa yin/ sha kham re dang*/ khrag thigs re gtong ngo zer yang sems stong nyid steng du tsen ne zhog cig dang*/ gsod pa ga la/ sen mo gcig tsam yang 'debs pa mi yong gi /phyar ba bting*/ gri bdar/ zangs btsugs nas khyod bsad de bshas nas zangs 'dir 'tshed pa yin zer yang rig pa dngos med kyi ngang du stong phyad de zhog dang khab tsam zhig kyang rdeg mkhan mi yong bar 'dug gi

/mi nag po chen po zhig gis sa la thag pa bkram/ ske la zhags pa btags nas khyod sbrags nas khur 'gro ba yin zer yang*/ blo nyam nga med pa'i ngang du 'bol le zhog dang*/ gom pa gang yang khur mkhan mi yong bar gda'i/ lar yang bar chad cho 'phrul ci byung yang bdag la bsrung du gsol/ skyabs su gsol brgya tham pa bas sod cig zo zhig khyer cig dga' ba yin/ lha srung brgya ra mda' la phab pa bas lha 'dre stong la za ru bcug pa dga' ba yin/ bsrung ba brgya lus la 'dog pa bas/ na dga' shi skyid tshig gcig rgyud la skyes pa dga' ba yin/ bdud kyi dmag dpung*/ gshin rje'i pho nya mtshon thogs dung phyur gyis mtha' nas bskor nas bdud kyi khram kha khyod la bskor/ btsan gyi rgyan kha khyod la phog /gshin rje'i za res khyod la bab zer yang sems gzhi med rtsa bral du phyam mer zhog dang*/ bdud dang gshin rje'i dmag bye ba dung phyur las/ rdog gcig kyang rtsa na mi 'dug la/ yongs ba'i rjes kyang mi 'dug pas so/ /de yang byin pa rang gis za mi nus kyi snyam pa'i gdengs bcas pas mi yong ste/ don la de thams cad bden par ma grub ste/ sems kyi cho 'phrul yid kyi blos byas/ rnam rtog gi sprul pa/ rig pa'i shes bzo nam mkha'i ri mo/ chu nang gi zla ba/ smig rgyu'i chu dang khyad med/ snang la don byed mi nus pa yin no/ / de thams cad bden par bzung mi dgos/ the tshom za mi dgos/ rtog pa za mi dgos/ sngon chad ri bong rwas su la brdung*/ mo gsham gyi bus su bsad/ sgyu ma'i skyes bus su la gnod pa bskyal/ smig rgyu'i chus su zhig khyer/ 'dag pa'i seng ges su la rmug /lha khang gi sgo khang na/ mgon po nag po khos nyin med mtshan med du dbyug pa thogs nas 'dug ste/ su la brgyab 'dug /de thams cad bden mi srid pa yin/ de ltar du shes pa'i mkhas pa de la bdud kyi tshogs kyis gnod mi nus te/

mdo las/ gang gā'i klung mnyam bye snyed zhing gi sems can rnams/ /de kun yongs su brtag par bzung ste bdud gyur pa/ /ba spu nyag re las kyang de snyed sprul byas kyang*/ /de dag kun gyis mkhas la bar chad bya mi nus/ /zhes so/ /gcod mkhan kha cig gcod la phyin nas slong rtags byung ma thag mtha' gtad log non byed pa yod de/ /des ni gcod kyi drod tshad ma shes pa yin/ bslangs ma thog gtad bya mi dgos/ lha 'dre'i rigs gtso/ cho 'phrul gyi lugs gtso/ gcod kyi dus tshod gtso ba yin/ lha 'dre drag po rtsub mo gcig dang thug na mtha' gtad bya'i/ 'jam na bya mi dgos/ cho 'phrul che drags na bya'i/ chung chung la bya mi dgos/ gcod tshar ba'i rjes la ci byas kyang ma chod na bya'i/ dang po rang nas bya mi dgos/ gcod mkhan kha cig na re/ ma chod pa gcod 'phro la lus pa dang*/ gcod 'phro bzhag pa dang*/ tshar tshad ma byung bar 'phro bcad nas log zer te/ sras rgyal ba don grub na re/ gang zag gi rigs gtso/ gcod mkhan rtogs pa dang ldan pas nang du bdag med rtogs/ phyi ru 'dre med du rtogs nas/ gcod la 'gro 'phro la log kyang chog /lus bdag 'dzin blos thongs nas gcod 'phro bzhag pa dang*/ tshar tshad ma byung ba la gcod 'phro shor yang ldog pa dang bar chad mi 'ong ste/ de thams cad sems kyis byed pa yin gsungs so/ /da res gcod 'phro bcad la ldog pa'i thabs zhig bya snyam nas 'phro bcad na/ de rang log non chen po yin gsungs so/ de rnams ni log chen mtha' la gtad pa'i gdam pa yin no/ /theg chen zil gyis mnan pa ni/ phyi ru bdud kyi bar chad nang du bde sdug chags sdang*/ dga' mi dga' la sogs rtog pa phra rags ji snyed cig shar yang*/ dran med yid la mi byed pa theg pa chen po'i lta bas zil gyis mnan na/ gtod la mnan/ thebs 'og tu bcug nas ldang mi nus par bya'o/ /dper na nam mkha' la zla ba yang nyi ma'i 'od kyis zil gyis mnan te/

skar chen thams cad nyi ma'i thebs 'og tu bcug nas rngo mi thogs pa bzhin lta ba rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ phyi ru bdud kyi bar chad dang nang chags sdang chos brgyad la sogs pa'i rtog pa phra rags skar ma dang 'dra ba ji snyed cig shar yang dran med yid la mi byed pa'i lta ba nyi ma dang 'dra ba des zil gyis mnan nas ldang mi nus pa'o/ /gnyan thog tu gnyan dbab pa ni/ phyi na klu'i pho brang gnyan/ de bas kyang lta ba rtogs pa'i sems nyid gnyan te/ klu'i pho brang ni gnyan sar bzung bas gnyan pa tsug snang ba yin/ don la gnyan rgyu med/ kun rdzob yin/ blos byas yin 'dus byas yin pas 'jig par nus/ bsreg tu btub/ gcad du btub ste/ lta ba rtogs pa'i sems nyid la gcad du med gang gis kyang gzhom par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du phyi na bdud kyi grong khyer gnyan te/ de bas kyang sems nyid don rtogs stong nyid gnyan/ bdud kyi grong khyer gong gis 'gre'o/ gshin rje'i pho brang*/ ma mo'i 'du sa/ rgyal po'i yul 'khor/ btsan gyi sku mkhar la sogs pa de rnams su rtogs pa'i gdeng gis nyams nga bag tsha med par 'gro ba ni/ gnyan thog tu gnyan dbab pa zhes bya/ kun rdzob rdzun khung rdib/ rnam rtog gtan la phebs/ bdag 'dzin yul nas thon/ lha 'dre sgyu mar zhig pa'i chos yin pas/ dper na sprang po gang du phyin yang nor med pas dgra mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /gcod mkhan la bdag 'dzin med pas 'dre mi 'byung ngo*/ / gdug rtsub cho 'phrul che na lha 'dre ar la mnan/ /ci nas klan ka brko na smyon pa'i brtul zhugs gyis/ /de ru cho 'phrul ston na na bde shi skyid bya/ /kun la byams pa'i sems kyis thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung*/ / zhes pa ni spyir gcod mkhan gyi chos lugs kyis/ lha 'dre la do mi bsdo/ 'gran mi 'dzugs/ gnod pa mi skyel/ rang dman sa 'dzin/ pham kha len/ bde sdug ci byung yang nam phugs su lus ster la re ba zhig yin no/

/ci byas kyang mi lo na/ khyod khyer cig bos kyang mi nyan pas/ skabs su smyon pa'i brtul zhugs byas la/ shi phung gang la'ang bsre dgos pa yin pa zhal nas/ skabs su rig pa'i rbad khams ma btang na phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyis sa mi non gsungs so/ / smyon pa'i brtul zhugs ni shing gnyan gcod pa/ sa gnyan slog pa/ brag gnyan gshog pa/ ne'u gsing gnyan po brko ba/ bra ma gcod pa/ chu mig dkrug pa la sogs pa byas la/ khyod kyis gnod pa ma bskyal yang nam phugs nga 'chi ba las ma 'das/ khyod kyis ma gnod kyi steng du srung skyob byas kyang nga'i srog mi zin/ mthar thug dmyal ba'i gnas su rang gi las ma log na snang srid lha 'dre thams cad log kyang bskyur bar mi nus so/ /zhag rdog gnyis gsum gyi tshe la ring thung mi 'dug gi /do nub rang 'chi ru chugs shig byas la/ spyod pa rtsub mo rnams bya/ rten dang pho brang gnas sa de/ bshigs la khyim du log mi yong bar de la mgo gtad la nyal lo/ /rmi lam du cho 'phrul ci byung yang gnyid sad pa dang*/ de la bsam blo mi btang bar chos nyid kyi ngang du lhan ne bzhag /blos bskyur gyi gnyen po gzhu brdung ba bzhin/ thang lhod ma shor bar bya/ der yang ma zad de/ shing sdong gnyan po gcod pa dang*/ brag dang pha bong gnyan po gshog pa dang*/ gnyan sar mkhar las byed pa dang*/ dgon pa 'debs na dang po rang nas shing gcod pa la sogs mi bya bar gnyan sa de ru gcod lan gsum byas la gnyan sa der sa rgod dul du bcug la/ de nas shing gcod pa la sogs pa'i mkhar las byas pas chog /dang po gcod kyi dus su dul du ma bcug par mkhar las byas na mi 'ong bas/ 'di ni mgo shong tsa na lus tshang ba'i gdams ngag bya ba yin te gnad che ba'o/ /de ltar byas nas kyang*/ lha 'dre'i las ngan sdig pa 'dag pa dang gdul byar skye ba'i smon lam btab/ spyod pa 'jam rtsub ci byas kyang lha 'dre'i don du bsgom/

stong nyid snying rjes zin par byas pas bdag gzhan thams cad lam log par mi ltung ba yin/ yang dag pa'i lam du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod/ tshar tshad dus rtags mngon sum nyams snang rmi lam 'byung*/ /phyi nang gsang gsum rang la 'char bar rig par bya/ /stong nyid ngang du rtse gcig bsam gtan mnyam bzhag na/ /'khor 'das kun gyi 'khrug shan 'byed par the tshom med/ /zhes pa'i tshar chod pa'i tshad la gsum/ dus kyi tshar tshad dang*/ rtags kyi tshar tshad dang*/ mthar thug gi tshar tshad do/ /dang po zhag gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs par bar ma chad par byas na tshar tshad 'byung*/ rtags kyi tshar tshad la gsum/ phyi ru lha 'dre'i tshar tshad chod pa'i rtags/ nang rgyud la yon tan skyes pa'i rtags/ lha 'dre dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags so/ /dang po ni lus kyi na tsha dang skyon dang lus rtags thams cad zhi ba dang*/ sems kyi skyon snying rlung dang*/ khams 'dus dang sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa dang*/ rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad zhi nas nyams snang mthong snang dang*/ rmi lam gyi gdug rtsub dang thams cad nyal gyis zhi nas blo bde 'bol ler 'gro /nyams dga' yal gyis 'gro /bag dro 'ur re 'gro/ nang du rgyud la yon tan skyes pa'i rtags ni/ gnyan khrod la sogs pa'i gnas der/ nyams dga' zhing sdod snying 'dod pa dang*/ byin chags shing bag dro ba dang*/ dge sbyor byed snying 'dod pa sngar bas 'phel ba/ sngar med pa'i nyams rtogs dang ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skye ba dang*/ snang ba 'di gtad med bden med du song ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje khyad par can skye ba dang*/ bla ma la mos gus lhag par skye ba 'byung*/ rkyen gang byung yang dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'char/ 'gal rkyen la nyam nga bag tsha med pa 'byung ngo*/ /de rnams tshar tshad yin no/ /rab tu tshar tshad de rnams thams cad dang*/ tha ma'ang gang rung zhig ma byung gi bar du ldab tshan bskyed/

blo gdengs tshugs tshugs su sdug bsran bskyed/ snying rus bskyed/ mnag pa bcangs la dpa' bskyed nas bsdad do/ tha na shi la thug kyang tshur la mi ldog par nyams su blang ngo*/ /de'i dus su tshar tshad ma byung ba la mi dga' ba mi bya/ byung na dga' ba'i blo mi bya/ byung ma byung dga' mi dga' mi bya ba re dogs spang blang med par gtad med du bskyur la bzhag go /re dogs kyi blo zhig 'dug na/ de ka'ang bdud yin pas bskyur la btang*/ snang ba 'di gnyis su snang ba zhig 'dug na'ang*/ snang thog du ma zhen par bden med du shes na lam du 'gro ba yin no/ / lha 'dre dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags ni/ rnal 'byor pa nyams len che 'bring chung gsum gyi nyams snang*/ dngos sam rmi lam du 'byung ste/ rang la lha 'dres bza' btung 'dren pa dang*/ bsu ba byed gus pas 'dud/ nor 'bul/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal skor ba byed pa dang*/ chos zhu ba srog sngags 'bul ba dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub ster ba 'byung ngo*/ /de tsa na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ za khrim 'bogs pa dang*/ dge ba'i lam la 'god par bya'o/ /le lag las/ dngos grub klu dang bdud las 'byung*/ /yon bdag btsan dang rgyal pos byed/ /zas nor ma mo mkha' 'gros sbyor/ /snyan pa snang srid lha 'dres sgrog /ces so/ / mthar thug gi tshar tshad bsgrub pa ni/ gcod byed pa rnams kyang gnas skabs su nad drag /gdon zhi/ mdze sos na de kas chog par byed/ gcod kyi dgos pa 'bras bu byung snyam nas/ phyis gcod kyi dge sbyor mi skyong ba yod de/ de ni gcod kyi 'bras bu phran tshegs yin pas/ des mi chog ste/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar du bskyed dgos te/ le lag las/ 'dod pa'i blo mi bya/ 'phral gyi phan yon nam/ yon tan bag tsam byung ba la chog shes mi bya/ ngom pa mi skyen par bya/ rang tshod mi bzung*/ mchog gi yon tan zhig ma skyes bar du nyams len la rtsal sbyang bar bya'o/

/'khor 'das mnyam pa zhig ma rtogs gi bar du nyams su len par bya'o/ /lar mngon sum rmi lam la sogs par cho 'phrul chen po ston cing bar chad ston na lha 'dre ji ltar gnyan yang gcod snying rus che rkyen thog tu 'gel tshabs che zhing*/ glod tshan bskyed nas bsdad na mi chod mi srid/ mi non mi srid/ dbang du mi 'dus mi srid do/ /dper na mkhar dang sgyogs thug na sgyogs rgyal 'gro /sdong po dang st+wa re thug na st+wa re rgyal 'gro / rdo dang tho ba thug na tho ba rgyal 'gro /shing dang me thug na me dpung rgyal 'gro ba bzhin kun rdzob dang don dam thug na don dam rgyal 'gro /dngos po dang dngos med thug na dngos med rgyal 'gro /lha 'dre dang gcod mkhan thug na/ gcod mkhan rgyal 'gro ba chos nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe skyon dang yon tan/ bar chad dang dngos grub gnyis kyi chos ci byung yang sems la mtho dman med par bya'o/ /'gal rkyen byung ba la yid ma zhum/ mthun rkyen byung ba la gzengs ma mtho/ blo shing bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin du/ phyad phyod du ma song bar bya/ srang kha'i bya sgro bzhin du yad yud la ma song bar bya/ lam kha'i sbur ma bzhin du 'khras 'khris la ma song bar byas la/ bdag 'dzin bkar la 'don/ gces 'dzin thad la bor la/ lus sems kyi thog tu mi 'tshams pa lam du blang*/ dka' ba ci byung yang sems kho rang yin/ kho dngos med yin/ dngos med stong pa yin snyam pas glod la bzhag /snang ba gtad med la yin min rtsis gdab med/ sems stong nyid la bde sdug gi rtog dpyod ma btang*/ tshogs drug bden med la chags sdang gi las mi 'chol bar bya'o/ /sngon 'gro slong rtags med na slong pa'i blo dang phrol/ dngos gzhi non rtags med na zhe 'dod rgyab tu bskyur/ mjug tu tshar tshad med na tshar 'dod blo dang phrol/ 'dod blo re dogs bdud yin mkhas pas spangs bar bya/ /zhes pa ni/ sngon 'gro la lha 'dre slong rtags dgos pa la ma byung*/

dngos gzhi la non rtags dgos pa la ma byung*/ mjug tu tshar tshad dgos pa la de ma byung*/ sngon 'gro la ma bslangs na dngos gzhi la gnon rgyu mi 'byung ste/ dri ma ma bslangs par chus bshal rgyu med pa dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi la ma non na rjes la tshar tshad mi 'byung ste/ dgra ma thul na dbang du mi 'dus pa dang 'dra bas/ gang la gcad dka' ba de ru ma chod nas/ phyi 'brang shor na rang la bar chad kyis ma tshugs kyang*/ 'khor la bar chad 'ong*/ tha na phyugs la god kha tshun chad 'ong ngo*/ /de gcad pa la phyi 'brang ma chod pa thams cad bdag 'dzin blos ma thongs pas yin/ bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas blos thongs na/ phyi 'brang ma chod kyang chog ste/ phyir 'brangs kyang 'gal ba med pa'i phyir/ des na sngon 'gro slong slong po zhig 'dod na'ang re ba'i bdud yin pas ma bslangs kyang chog snyam pa bya/ dngos gzhi non po zhig 'dod na re dogs kyi bdud yin pas/ ma non na'ang ma non cig snyam du bya'o/ /mjug tshar tshad chod po cig 'dod na'ang re dogs kyi bdud yin pas tshar tshad ma 'ongs na'ang ma 'ongs snyam pa bya/ da tshar tshad zhig 'ong thang ba la/ byung na dga' ste snyam par mi bya'o/ /lar gcod mkhan phal cher/ dang po lha 'dre slong pa zhig 'dod/ bar du non pa zhig 'dod/ tha ma tshar chod pa zhig 'dod/ lha 'dre pham pa rang rgyal ba zhig 'dod/ khyad thon pa pho shan phyed pa zhig 'dod/ de ni ma tshor ba'i bdud yin pas/ gcod 'di yi bzhed pa'i gdams ngag dbang po rab gdams pa 'di dang ldan pa zhig gis/ gnyan khrod du gcod byas na/ dang po slong rtags/ bar du non rtags/ tha ma tshar tshad de rnams mi 'dod kyang 'ong ste 'ong ba chos nyid yin/ 'ong la re dang byung la dga'/ byung ba la nga rgyal dang rlom pa mi bya'o/ /le lag las/ dngos po spangs kyang stong par 'dod/ / stong pa cir yang ma dmigs pa/ /dngos po 'dzin pa smos ci dgos/ /ma rtogs pa 'di dbang re che/

/zhes so/ phan dang gnod byas 'jam dang rtsub pa'i spyod pa brtul/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis byang chub lam bkod smon lam btab/ /ces pa ni/ nyams kyi tshar tshad byung gcod tshar tshad gyi dang lar ni thams cad kyi don la smon lam btab par bya'o/ /lha 'dre rnams kyis dang po bdag la cho 'phrul gdug rtsub bstan/ gnod pa bskyal ba dang*/ phyis gus pas 'atud phan btags pa dang rang gis kyang spyod lam 'jam pos lus sbyin par btang ba dang*/ spyod pa rtsub mos kho la gnod pa bskyal ba dang thabs sna tshogs kyis lha 'dre byang chub la bkod pa'i dge ba la brten nas/ lha 'dre khyed rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub pa nyon mongs pa'i gdug rtsub zhi nas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig khyod kyis bdag la sngar tho 'tsham zhing gnod pa bskyal ba dang phyis mos pa byas shing gus pas 'dud pa'i dge ba la brten nas rgyal po byams pa'i stobs dang gnod sbyin sha za spun lnga bzhin du/ bdag gi 'khor 'dus pa dang por skye bar gyur cig khyod kyi las ngan sdig sgrib mi dge ba'i rgyu 'bras bag chags sa bon dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig 'di nyid la byang zhing dag nas kun mkhyen gyi sangs rgyas rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /rnal 'byor pa bdag gis kyang lus sbyin par btang ba dang*/ byams pa'i sems kyis lha 'dre rjes su bzung ba'i dge ba la brten nas/ rgyal po zla 'od dam rgyal bu dge don bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /mthar thug bdag gzhan don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /de rnams ni lha 'dre'i 'gro don yin pas mi'i 'gro don las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis 'phrin las stobs che'o/ /de rnams phyi gcod pa'i gdams ngag go / bdag gzhan don du kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas/
